It is a clone of the original Made-in-Japan version and features the same single quad op amp circuit with the MC3403 chip. The pedal is designed with all through-hole components and full-sized, panel-mounted hardware. The controls on the Li’l Yellow OD include a Level knob, which adjusts the output volume of the pedal, and a Drive knob, which controls the amount of overdrive or distortion. There is also a Tone knob, which allows you to shape the tone of the overdrive effect. The pedal is built with a compact footprint, making it suitable for smaller pedalboards or tight spaces. It is designed to be easy to assemble and can be a great option for DIY enthusiasts or those looking to build their own pedal. Summary created by AI from the original source.
